content.text: The reports line up with several code paths: mention lookup stops at 100 members and excludes viewers, alerts are sent separately without deduplication, and thread loading only includes direct replies. Edits also leave mentions and search unchanged and use the last edit time for the deadline. I’ll fix these together and move posting limits to individual members.
